mLocKeys.keySummary: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Orianna commands her <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor> to unleash a shockwave, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to nearby enemies and <status>Knocking</status> them in the direction of the <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies.

The pulse leaves behind an energy field for @FieldDuration@ seconds, Slowing enemies by @SlowAmount*100@% and granting allies @HasteAmount*100@% Move Speed, decaying over @SlowAndHasteDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Watchful Guardian</titleLeft><mainText>This champion is being watched over by the Ball, gaining additional defenses.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Orianna commands her <keywordMajor>Ball</keywordMajor> to move to an area, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage</magicDamage> to surrounding enemies and to enemies it passes through. Deals @ReducedDamagePercent@% less damage to all enemies after the first.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: The Ball adds @DefenseBonus@ Armor and @DefenseBonus@ Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to.

Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them @TotalShieldTooltip@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take @TotalDamageTooltip@ magic damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Command: Protect</titleLeft><mainText>This champion is shielded from damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Orianna's Abilities originate from her Ball. Orianna's Ball automatically returns to her if she is too far away from it.

Orianna's Attacks deal an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within @StackDuration@ seconds deal an additional @StackDamage@ magic damage (max of @StackDamageMax@ damage).
